operation: Bounded vertical-envelope density of retained body/crown draw geometry. At each .25m XZ node, analytic float64 triangle intersections supply min/max Y; fill that entire interval, including visible air below overhangs. Nearest original face sets bounded magnitude. This is not a shape-preserving or exact CSG conversion. Outcrop props are excluded from the source and disappear in this unified study. Exact upper/lower ties belong to air. No new model or runtime overlay. Within .35m of a cap above a >.7m column, use vertical cap distance rather than nearest composite internal face, keeping the cap interpolation uniform.
stage: Unaccepted local conversion, not proof of source closure or default art acceptance.
ray_vote_note: Not applicable: this version does not classify points with rays.
